title: Welcome to DataBall!
excerpt: School sports, scores, and stories — in one place.
body:
Hi guys! Welcome to DataBall!
This is our DDHS sports desk: a home for scores, brackets, rankings, Elo, records, and the stories behind match day. Basketball, soccer, volleyball, and frisbee all live here — along with classes, players, and the league as it unfolds.

Check today’s games, read the latest posts, and follow your class through the season. Editors will keep the board updated; everyone else is invited to watch, share, and stay in the conversation.

Glad you’re here. Have fun and let’s go!

—

欢迎来到 DataBall。

这里是校园体育媒体台：比分、对阵、排名、Elo、纪录，以及赛场前后的故事，都会发布在这个站点。篮球、足球、排球、飞盘，连同班级、球员和联赛进程，都可以在这里找到。

可以看今日赛程、读最新报道，也可以跟着自己班级走完整个赛季。编辑会持续更新内容；欢迎大家来一起关注。

玩的开心！
